objective_for_doctor:
Age: 43
Sex: M
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I have pain—it's a 7 out of 10. It feels tedious, sensitive, tugging, heavy, and sharp, and it’s located in my right and left ankles, the lateral side of my left foot, and both thighs. The pain intensity is about a 7/10, and it starts at a pace of 4/10. I also have swelling in my ankle (right), thigh (left), the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of the left foot.
When did these symptoms first begin, and did they start suddenly or develop gradually?
I don’t know. But the pain appears at a pace of 4 out of 10.
Have you had any recent long-distance travel, surgery, prolonged periods of immobility, or a personal history of blood clots?
I’ve had deep vein thrombosis (DVT).
Are you currently experiencing any shortness of breath, chest pain, or coughing up blood?
I don’t know.
Is the skin over the swollen areas noticeably warm, red, or discolored compared to the unaffected areas?
I don’t know.
When you press firmly on the swollen areas for a few seconds, does it leave a visible indentation (pitting), or does the skin spring back immediately?
I don’t know.
Are you currently taking any blood-thinning medications, or have you recently started or stopped any new prescriptions?

I don’t know. I don’t know about blood-thinning medications specifically.

I am currently taking or I have recently taken NSAIDs, and I take corticosteroids. I also have liver cirrhosis and a known issue with one of my heart valves.
Does the swelling and pain fluctuate throughout the day, typically worsening with prolonged standing or walking and improving after resting with your legs elevated?
I don’t know.
Have you noticed any recent unexplained weight gain or increased abdominal swelling?
I don’t know. But I do have swelling in my right ankle, left thigh, the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of my left foot.
Have you had any fever, chills, or noticed any open wounds or skin breakdown on your swollen legs or feet?
I don’t know. But I do have swelling in my right ankle, left thigh, the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of my left foot.
Did the swelling and pain in your left thigh begin more suddenly than the swelling in your feet and ankles?

I don’t know. But I have swelling in my left thigh and also in my right ankle, the dorsal aspects of both feet, and the sole of my left foot. I also have pain in both thighs and in my right and left ankles, plus the lateral side of my left foot.
[DDX] Recurrent deep vein thrombosis, Congestive heart failure exacerbation, Cirrhosis-related fluid retention/hypoalbuminemia, Medication-induced edema, Chronic venous insufficiency
